    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Tauri2.8+Vue3聊天系统|vite7+tauri2+element-plus客户端仿微信聊天程序</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;; color: rgba(30, 158, 224, 1)">最新款<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">tauri2+vite7+pinia3</span>仿微信/QQ电脑端聊天软件<em>Tauri2Chat</em>。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><strong>tauri2-vue3-chat</strong>最新原创<span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 255, 1)">Tauri2.8+Vite7.1+Vue3+Pinia3+ElementPlus</span>桌面端仿QQ/微信界面聊天应用。<span style="background-color: rgba(245, 208, 250, 1)">封装高复用tauri2多窗体、自定义圆角阴影窗口/导航条</span>。提供了<strong>聊天、通讯录、收藏、朋友圈/短视频、我的</strong>等板块。</span></p>
<p><img alt="360截图20251021233301426" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022093851214-1464181795.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>运用技术</h3>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">编辑器：vscode</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">跨平台框架：tauri2.8</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">前端技术框架：vite^7.1.10+vue^3.5.22+vue-router^4.6.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">状态管理：pinia^3.0.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">本地存储：pinia-plugin-persistedstate^4.5.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">UI组件库：element-plus^2.11.5</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">富文本编辑器：@vueup/vue-quill^1.2.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">样式预处理：sass^1.93.2</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">短视频滑动插件：swiper^12.0.2</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="p2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022094134938-705601068.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="p6" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022094246099-1474168463.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>项目框架目录</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">tauri2-vite7-wechat客户端聊天项目采用最新跨平台技术&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">tauri2.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span></span>&nbsp;整合&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">vite7</span>&nbsp;搭建项目框架。</span></p>
<p><img alt="360截图20251021221317391" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022094511293-438781959.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="p5-1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022094613273-322519869.gif" class="lazyload"></p>

<h4><em>Tauri2-ViteChat聊天系统已经更新到我的原创作品集，感谢支持！</em></h4>

</blockquote>
<h3>tauri2.0结合vite.js搭建项目</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022095444618-835802175.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">之前有写过一篇关于tauri2结合vite.js搭建桌面端项目、创建多窗口、自定义托盘闪烁及右键菜单。有兴趣的可以去看看。</span></p>
<p><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoyan2017/p/18416811" target="_blank"><span style="font-size: 12px">https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoyan2017/p/18416811</span></a></p>
<p><img alt="p1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022095909416-1041481714.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">tauri2-vue3-chat实现类似QQ登录/主窗口切换，支持主题壁纸、自定义最大化/最小化/关闭按钮，新窗口打开朋友圈/短视频。聊天模块支持新开窗口预览图片/视频、拖拽图片到聊天区域。</span></p>
<p><img alt="360截图20251021221317398" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022095944953-1302498593.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>项目布局模板</h3>
<p><img alt="360截图20251021221317394" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022100450393-1367708418.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">项目整体分为<strong>左侧菜单栏+侧边栏+内容区(自定义导航条)</strong>等板块。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022100625641-451414564.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<h3>项目入口配置main.js</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>import { createApp } from 'vue'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import </span>'./style.scss'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import App from </span>'./App.vue'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入组件库</span>
import VEPlus from 've-plus'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

<h3>tauri2+vue3自定义无边框圆角阴影窗口</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022102308888-1696764064.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022102540515-413510423.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022102602956-673273510.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022102726057-1970120474.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 12px">设置&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">decorations: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span></span>&nbsp;无边框模式。结合&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">transparent: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span></span>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">shadow: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span></span>&nbsp;实现自定义圆角阴影窗口。</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 12px">tauri设置无边框窗口后，开启拖拽功能直接在需要拖拽的元素标签设置&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">data-tauri-drag-region</span>&nbsp;属性，另外tauri还支持css设置拖拽功能。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 拖拽
.vu__drag </span>{<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">-webkit-app-region</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> drag</span>;}<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
// 取消拖拽
.vu__undrag </span>{<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">-webkit-app-region</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> no-drag</span>;}</pre>
</div>
<h3>Tauri2+Vite7封装多开窗口</h3>
<p><img alt="013360截图20251022074406464" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022103614173-246184881.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 创建新窗口
 * @param {object} args 窗口配置参数 {label: 'home', url: '/home', width: 850, height: 610, ...}
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
export async </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> winCreate(args) {
  await emit(</span>'win-create'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, args)
}</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主窗口</span>
export async <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mainWindow() {
  await winCreate({
    label: </span>'main'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    url: </span>'/'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    title: </span>'TAURI-WINCHAT'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    width: </span>850<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    height: </span>620<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    minWidth: </span>700<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    minHeight: </span>450<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  })
}

  await winCreate({
    label: </span>'main-login'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    url: </span>'/login'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    title: </span>'登录'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    width: </span>320<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    height: </span>420<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    resizable: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

    alwaysOnTop: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  })

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 关于窗口</span>
export async <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> aboutWindow() {
  await winCreate({
    label: </span>'win-about'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    url: </span>'/win/about'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

    minWidth: </span>320<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    minHeight: </span>350<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    maximizable: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

  })
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置窗口</span>
export async <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> settingWindow() {
  await winCreate({
    label: </span>'win-setting'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    url: </span>'/win/setting'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    title: </span>'设置'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    width: </span>550<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    height: </span>470<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    resizable: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    maximizable: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  })
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>自定义窗口配置参数</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 系统窗口参数(与tauri的new WebviewWindow()参数一致)</span>
const windowBaseOptions =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 窗口唯一标识label</span>
  label: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 窗口标题</span>
  title: ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 窗口路由地址</span>
  url: ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 宽度</span>
  width: 850<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 高度</span>
  height: 620<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最小宽度</span>
  minWidth: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最小高度</span>
  minHeight: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 窗口x坐标</span>
  x: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 窗口y坐标</span>
  y: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 窗口居中显示(当设置x/y，则需要设置为false)</span>
  center: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否可缩放</span>
  resizable: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否可最小化</span>
  minimizable: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否可最大化</span>
  maximizable: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否可关闭</span>
  closable: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最大化窗口</span>
  maximized: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 父窗口句柄label</span>
  parent: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 窗口是否置顶</span>
  alwaysOnTop: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否显示窗口边框(要创建无边框窗口，将decorations参数设置为false)</span>
  decorations: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否透明窗口</span>
  transparent: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否显示窗口阴影</span>
  shadow: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建时是否显示窗口</span>
  visible: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 禁止系统拖放</span>
  dragDropEnabled: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>tauri2+vue3自定义托盘闪烁|消息提醒|托盘菜单</h3>
<p><img alt="012360截图20251022073317041" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022104209800-1075097306.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="012360截图20251022073147132" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022104140913-1749241478.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="48b25ff48ccefb11103ab70a93001ad1_1289798-20240928105906610-113063713" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022104040740-431127253.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 自定义托盘图标
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

use tauri::{
  tray::{MouseButton, TrayIconBuilder, TrayIconEvent}, Emitter, Manager, Runtime
};

pub fn tray_create</span>&lt;R: Runtime&gt;(app: &amp;tauri::AppHandle&lt;R&gt;) -&gt; tauri::Result&lt;()&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  let _ </span>= TrayIconBuilder::with_id("tray"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .tooltip(</span>"TAURI-WINCHAT"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .icon(app.default_window_icon().unwrap().clone())
    .on_tray_icon_event(</span>|tray, event|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> match event {
      TrayIconEvent::Click {
        id: _,
        position,
        rect: _,
        button,
        button_state: _,
      } </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> match button {
        MouseButton::Left {} </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
          let windows </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tray.app_handle().webview_windows();
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (key, value) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> windows {
            println</span>!("点击左键: {}"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, key);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> key == "main-login" || key == "main"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
              value.show().unwrap();
              value.unminimize().unwrap();
              value.set_focus().unwrap();
            }
          }
        }
        MouseButton::Right {} </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
          println</span>!("点击右键"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
          tray.app_handle().emit(</span>"tray_contextmenu"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, position).unwrap();
        }
        _ </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}
      },
      TrayIconEvent::Enter {
        id: _,
        position,
        rect: _,
      } </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        println</span>!("鼠标滑过托盘"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        tray.app_handle().emit(</span>"tray_mouseenter"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, position).unwrap();
      }
      TrayIconEvent::Leave {
        id: _,
        position,
        rect: _,
      } </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        println</span>!("鼠标离开托盘"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        tray.app_handle().emit(</span>"tray_mouseleave"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, position).unwrap();
      }
      _ </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}
    })
    .build(app);
  Ok(())
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="p7" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022104002525-1939244736.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251022104325690-24586566.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * Tauri自定义系统托盘右键菜单
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

import { WebviewWindow } from </span>'@tauri-apps/api/webviewWindow'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import { LogicalPosition } from </span>'@tauri-apps/api/window'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import { listen } from </span>'@tauri-apps/api/event'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

import { authState } from </span>'@/pinia/modules/auth'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> async <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TrayContextMenu() {
  console.log(</span>'create tray contextmenu...'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

  const authstate </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> authState()

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 右键菜单宽度</span>
  let menuW = 150
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 右键菜单高度</span>
  let menuH = authstate.authorization ? 300 : 48<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

  let webview </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> WebviewWindow('win-traymenu'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, {
    url: </span>'/tray/contextmenu'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    title: </span>'托盘右键菜单'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    width: menuW,
    height: menuH,
    x: window.screen.width,
    y: window.screen.height,
    skipTaskbar: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    transparent: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    shadow: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    decorations: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    center: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    resizable: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    alwaysOnTop: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    focus: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    visible: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  })

  await webview.listen(</span>'tauri://window-created', async() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    const win </span>= await WebviewWindow.getByLabel('win-traymenu'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    win.hide()
  })
  await webview.listen(</span>'tauri://blur', async() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    const win </span>= await WebviewWindow.getByLabel('win-traymenu'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    win.hide()
  })
  await webview.listen(</span>'tauri://error', async(error) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    console.log(</span>'traymenu error!'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error)
  })

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 监听托盘右键菜单事件</span>
  listen('tray_contextmenu', async(event) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    console.log(</span>'tray_contextmenu: '<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, event)

    let position </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> event.payload
    const win </span>= await WebviewWindow.getByLabel('win-traymenu'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(!win) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    win.setAlwaysOnTop(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    win.setFocus()
    win.setPosition(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> LogicalPosition(position.x - 5, position.y - menuH + 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
    win.show()
  })
}</span></pre>
</div>
